## Glyphling 0.9.5 (test build for 1.0)

Download `Glyphling-Setup-0.9.5.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place, keeping settings, themes and position.

### New
- **Volume check** (Settings > Music): lists every audio session Windows has in the volume mixer (app, output device, state, volume), marks the ones the circle's volume would move, and "Test volume" briefly moves them and reads the value back, so we can see whether the app accepts or resets the change.

### Changed
- The volume now looks for an app's audio sessions on every active output device, not only the default one.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway").
